read.thesis: Carrier raised FY26 guidance to ~$23B sales, ~$3.5B adj. op. profit and ~$2.90 adj. EPS on ~40% total orders growth, though Q2 adj. operating margin fell 190 bps to 17.2%.

triggers.label: FY26 sales guide ~$22B → ~$23B

triggers.label: Total orders up ~40%
triggers.quote: Total company orders 1 up ~40%; Commercial HVAC 1 up ~65%; data centers up >300%

triggers.label: CSA margin down 260 bps on mix and input costs
